## Summary

Describe the scoped problem and why this change is necessary. Link the issue and PRD requirement (if applicable).

## What changed

Include files/modules, visible behavior, dependency additions and alternatives considered.

## Validation

- [ ] Exact test/build/lint commands and results are included below.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria tested (or skips explained).
- [ ] Security/tenant isolation and secret handling reviewed.
- [ ] Licensing and operating costs checked for new dependencies.
- [ ] Documentation and docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md updated.
- [ ] No unapproved third-party code, private data or credentials committed.

### Commands and evidence

Describe what actually ran. Attach redacted screenshots or logs when useful.

## Risks, limitations and follow-ups

List unfinished functionality and any blockers without claiming it is complete.
